notices.title: EVACUATION NOTICE
notices.display:
NORTH DISTRICT RELIEF OFFICE
EVACUATION NOTICE
Ref. NDR-EVAC-0112 · Issued 12 November 2026
Buses to the safe zone leave from North School at 9:00 on Friday.
Please arrive by 8:30. Each family may bring two bags.
Bring your ID cards and your children's school documents.
Do not gather at the Old Bridge.
Volunteers in green vests will help older people and people with disabilities.
Issued by the North District Relief Office.
